01 / THE OPPORTUNITY

Make it work
harder for you.

Custom CRM development is useful when customer information is spread across WhatsApp, spreadsheets, forms and individual inboxes. We create a clear system for capturing enquiries, assigning ownership, tracking the next step and keeping useful customer context in one place.

The right CRM may include lead capture, pipelines, follow-up rules, reporting, permissions and connections to your website, WhatsApp or existing business tools. We start with the workflow and team adoption, then build only the features that support reliable use.

04 / GOOD TO KNOW

Before we
begin.

01When do we need a custom CRM?+

A custom CRM is useful when your customer process has requirements that off-the-shelf tools cannot support cleanly, or when important context is being lost between disconnected tools.

02Can a CRM connect with our website and WhatsApp?+

Often yes. We assess the available integration options, permissions and consent requirements before confirming the scope.

03Can we move data from spreadsheets?+

Yes. We can review the structure and quality of existing data, plan a safe migration and define who will own ongoing data quality.
